# Inputs copied (read-only) from DAS-map

Source repo: https://github.com/aljoudm/DAS-map-   commit `a25fd0c049b885904fc58288d21ea3840e9f0427` (15 Nov 2026).
The source repo was only READ; these are byte-for-byte copies so that this module is standalone.

| File here | Original path in DAS-map |
| --- | --- |
| cells.csv | results_zones/cells.csv |
| zones.mat | results_zones/zones.mat |
| boundary_perimeter.csv | data/boundary_perimeter.csv (OSM Haram + Arafat union, provisional) |
| roads_osm.mat | data/roads_osm.mat (OSM roads, used to place the ILLUSTRATIVE cameras) |
| roads_osm.json | data/roads_osm.json (same OSM ways WITH name / ref tags; the .mat above has no names) |
